landingCopy: Companion browser for the BRaVa recessive association study, bringing together gene-based recessive summary statistics across cohorts, ancestries, phenotypes, and variant annotations. Search by gene symbol, Ensembl ID, or phenotype to compare recessive and additive effects side by side.
